name: lever hip thrust
description: A machine version of the hip thrust that loads the glutes with a fixed path of motion.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your upper back against the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat, keeping your chin tucked.
